Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/37797

ref https://github.com/pingcap/tiflow/issues/3339

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?
* Support fetch info in `routes` config initialization and append them to DataFile info. 
* Append extend values to parser `lastRow` and modify column definition before kv encoder.
* Regenerate extend data for chunks loaded from checkpoint.

issue_context.title: lightning: support distinguishing data source when merge shared tables with no shared key
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...] -->
DM has already supported extract source table/schema information in https://github.com/pingcap/tiflow/issues/3340 to help distinguish different source data. Lightning is used in DM. If we want DM all mode support this feature, Lightning should also support this.

**Describe the feature you'd like:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. -->
Make lightning support extracting the table name to the target table column when merge shared tables without partition keys.

**Describe alternatives you've considered:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered. -->

**Teachability, Documentation, Adoption, Migration Strategy:**
<!-- If you can, explain some scenarios how users might use this, situations it would be helpful in. Any API designs, mockups, or diagrams are also helpful. -->

review_comments:
if we store `extend column` info in `MDTableMeta` we can pass this info from `MDTableMeta` to `TableRestore` into `chunkRestore`

so will not need this function to calculate `extend column` again
there's only one `extend column` for each table, no need to loop all data file
Same reason, different routed tables are included in one `tableInfo`.
should we also addExtendDataForCheckpoint for len(cp.Engine) == 0 case?

No. For `len(cp.Engine) == 0` case, metadata will be generated in datafile.FileMeta when we initilize files. It will to passed to chunks in `populateChunks`. If we load chunks from checkpoint we will lack this part, so we need to do this.
I think checking `len(ignoreColumns) > 0` is the same. This map will never be nil.
Because routed tables only have one `MDTableMeta` while several `SourceFileMeta`.
not sure if we should expose it to user by toml, because this seems a DM only feature request
It happens when we first initialize chunks. If its length is 0, it will be generated in the following `initializeColumns`
